nvitk.io.conversors.phase2volume
================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.io.conversors.phase2volume

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Phase-contrast / cine MRI-style tabular pipelines to 3D/4D volumes (CLI optional).

   4DFlow derivatives follow the QVTplus ``loadNII`` / ``calc_angio`` convention:
   time-mean angiography, velocity magnitude, complex-difference contrast, optional
   spatial polynomial background correction on velocity (see ``_phase2volume_bg``).

.. py:function:: _first_match(directory: pathlib.Path, *patterns: str) -> pathlib.Path | None

   First path in *directory* matching any of the glob *patterns*, tried in order.


.. py:function:: _find_direction_dirs(flow_dir: pathlib.Path) -> tuple[pathlib.Path, pathlib.Path, pathlib.Path]

   Identify the AP/RL/FH phase-direction subfolders under a 4DFlow directory by name matching.


.. py:function:: discover_phase_inputs(patient_dir: str | pathlib.Path) -> PhaseInputs

   Locate a patient's angio and AP/RL/FH phase DICOM inputs under their ``4DFlow`` folder.


.. py:function:: _normalize_venc_to_mm_s(raw: float, *, source_hint: str = '') -> float

   Interpret scalar as mm/s; values that look like cm/s are scaled by 10.


.. py:function:: _scalar_venc_from_raw(raw: Any, *, source_hint: str = '') -> float | None

   Parse a VENC scalar, including Philips ``(2001,101A)`` 3-float lists.

   For a length-3 list (one component per AP/FH/RL phase), the non-zero entry is
   the encoding magnitude for that series.


.. py:function:: _venc_from_json_payload(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> float | None

   Extract a VENC value (mm/s) from a JSON sidecar dict: explicit VENC/Philips tag first, then legacy cm/s fields.


.. py:function:: _venc_from_json_dir(ap_dir: pathlib.Path) -> tuple[float | None, str | None]

   Find a VENC value in any JSON sidecar under *ap_dir*; returns ``(value_mm_s, source_label)``.


.. py:function:: _venc_from_nifti_metadata(meta: dict[str, Any] | None) -> tuple[float | None, str | None]

   Find a VENC value in a NIfTI image's metadata dict; returns ``(value_mm_s, source_label)``.


.. py:function:: _venc_from_single_dicom(path: pathlib.Path) -> float | None

   Extract a VENC value (mm/s) from one DICOM file, trying Philips/standard/GE private tags in turn.


.. py:function:: _venc_from_dicom_directory(dicom_dir: pathlib.Path, *, max_files: int = 100) -> tuple[float | None, str | None]

   Scan up to *max_files* DICOMs under *dicom_dir* for a VENC value; returns ``(value_mm_s, source_label)``.


.. py:function:: resolve_venc_mm_s(*, ap_dir: pathlib.Path, default_mm_s: float = 700.0, ap_phase_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, magnitude_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, dicom_search_dir: pathlib.Path | None = None, log_context: str = '') -> tuple[float, str]

   Resolve VENC in mm/s: NIfTI metadata, then JSON sidecars, then DICOM, then default.

   Returns ``(venc_mm_s, source_tag)``. When falling back to default, logs a warning
   (MATLAB QVTplus often used fixed 700 mm/s when tags were absent).


.. py:function:: _calc_angio(angio_mag, v_mag, venc: float)

   QVTplus-style complex-difference magnitude: MAG * sin(pi/2 * min(|V|, VENC) / VENC).


.. py:function:: compute_phase_derivatives(angio_data, ap_phase, rl_phase, fh_phase, *, venc: float, background_phase_correction: bool = True, bg_poly_order: int = 2, bg_static_percentile: float = 25.0, cd_4d_background_correction: bool | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]

   Compute angiography, complex-difference, and velocity magnitude derivatives (QVTplus-aligned).

   Velocity in mm/s: ``vx = -RL_phase * 10``, ``vy = -AP_phase * 10``, ``vz = FH_phase * 10``.

   When ``background_phase_correction`` is True (default), fits spatial polynomials
   (order ``bg_poly_order``, default 2 per MATLAB ``loadNII`` ``fit_order``) on the
   temporal-mean field using low-speed voxels (``bg_static_percentile``), subtracts
   from each frame, then recomputes magnitudes and CD. MATLAB's cd_thresh/noise_thresh
   mask is not replicated; see ``_phase2volume_bg``.

   Arrays follow :func:`~nvitk.core.array.as_backend_array` (NumPy or CuPy per
   :mod:`nvitk.core.backend`).


.. py:function:: _write_outputs(flow_dir: pathlib.Path, outputs: dict[str, np.ndarray | None], metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> list[pathlib.Path]

   Write each non-``None`` output array as ``<flow_dir>/<name>.nii.gz`` with shape/axes metadata.


.. py:function:: utc_now() -> str

   Current UTC timestamp as an ISO-8601 string (for provenance metadata).


.. py:function:: process_patient(patient_dir: str | pathlib.Path, *, venc: float = 700.0, dry_run: bool = False, subject_uid: str | None = None, pipeline_id: str = '1.0.0', background_phase_correction: bool = True, bg_poly_order: int = 2, bg_static_percentile: float = 25.0, cd_4d_background_correction: bool | None = None, dicom_search_dir: pathlib.Path | None = None, backend: str = None) -> list[pathlib.Path]

   Convert one patient's 4D-flow phase DICOMs into velocity/CD/angio NIfTI volumes with VENC scaling and QC.

   Discovers the AP/RL/FH direction folders (:func:`discover_phase_inputs`),
   resolves VENC (explicit arg, else JSON sidecar, else NIfTI metadata, else
   DICOM tags), converts phase to velocity, optionally applies background
   phase correction, and writes the resulting volumes next to the input.


.. py:function:: phase2volume(input_path: str | pathlib.Path, *, multifile: bool = False, venc: float = 700.0, dry_run: bool = False, pipeline_id: str = '1.0.0', background_phase_correction: bool = True, bg_poly_order: int = 2, bg_static_percentile: float = 25.0, cd_4d_background_correction: bool | None = None, dicom_search_dir: pathlib.Path | None = None, backend: str = 'gpu') -> list[pathlib.Path]

   Library entry point behind the ``phase2volume`` CLI: convert one patient, or every patient under *input_path*
   when *multifile* is set.


.. py:function:: main(input_path: pathlib.Path, multifile: bool, venc: float, dicom_search_dir: pathlib.Path | None, background_phase_correction: bool, bg_poly_order: int, bg_static_percentile: float, dry_run: bool, pipeline_id_opt: str | None, pipeline_version_legacy: str | None, backend: str) -> None

   CLI entry point: convert one (or, with ``--multifile``, every) 4D-flow patient's phase DICOMs to NIfTI volumes.
